articles.title: Barabanki Tragedy: Tree Falls on Roadways Bus, 5 Dead Including Govt Officers
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Five people, including a teacher, two Assistant Development Officers, and a roadways driver, were killed on Friday when a tree fell on a Barabanki–Haidergarh roadways bus near Harkh intersection, Uttar Pradesh. Four of the deceased were women. One passenger is critically injured.

body.html:
Five people, including a teacher, two Assistant Development Officers, and a roadways driver, were killed on Friday when a tree fell on a Barabanki–Haidergarh roadways bus near Harkh intersection, Uttar Pradesh. Four of the deceased were women. One passenger is critically injured.

Police said the accident occurred around 11 AM when the driver swerved to avoid an animal, hitting an electric pole and then a tree. The impact caused the tree to crash onto the bus, crushing its roof. The bus was carrying about 60 passengers.

A video from the scene shows a trapped woman angrily telling a man filming, “We are dying and you are making videos… If you had helped remove the branch, we could have come out.”

Rescue operations lasted over 90 minutes, with locals, police, and a bulldozer removing the tree. The deceased were identified as Shiksha Malhotra (teacher), Meena Srivastava (ADO–Welfare), Juhi Saxena (ADO–Statistics), Rakibul Nisha, and driver Santosh Soni.

articles.title: Mumbai Horror Averted: Unattended Truck Rolls Into Bus Stop in Prabhadevi, Driver Flees Scene
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic gripped Mumbai’s Century Bazaar area on August 7 when an unattended container truck rolled downhill and rammed into a bus stop in Prabhadevi.

body.html:
Panic gripped Mumbai’s Century Bazaar area on August 7 when an unattended container truck rolled downhill and rammed into a bus stop in Prabhadevi. Fortunately, no injuries were reported, though the bus stop suffered heavy damage and traffic along the Worli–Dadar route was severely disrupted.

Police said the truck was parked on a slope near Oberoi 360 West Tower in Worli during unloading without proper safety measures. It began moving on its own, crossed the road divider, and crashed into the bus stop. The driver reportedly jumped out and fled.

Dadar Police have booked him for negligence and are reviewing CCTV footage as part of their probe.

articles.title: Haridwar Horror: Mountain Collapses Near Kali Temple — 3 Bikers Cheat Death
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Haridwar: A major landslide near Bhimgoda Kali Mata Temple on Tuesday evening narrowly missed claiming lives, disrupted train services, and caused panic among locals.

body.html:
Haridwar: A major landslide near Bhimgoda Kali Mata Temple on Tuesday evening narrowly missed claiming lives, disrupted train services, and caused panic among locals.

Around 7:30 pm on Tuesday, August 5, 2025, a section of the Mansa Devi hill broke off near the Bhimgoda railway tunnel, sending boulders and debris crashing onto the road and railway tracks. The impact was so powerful that it tore through the iron safety net installed to block falling debris.

Three bikers riding past at the time had a miraculous escape — CCTV footage shows them falling off their bike just as the debris crashed beside them.

The landslide damaged tracks on the Haridwar–Dehradun–Rishikesh route, forcing authorities to halt trains from both directions.

articles.title: Himachal Devastated: Cloudburst Hits Shimla, 3 Dead as Car Falls into River — 533 Roads Shut!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Himachal Pradesh: A cloudburst struck Shimla at 10:15 PM last night, flooding the Nogli drain. In Rohru, three youths died after their car fell into the Pabbar River due to heavy rain. A landslide also occurred on the Chandigarh-Manali four-lane highway.

body.html:
Himachal Pradesh: A cloudburst struck Shimla at 10:15 PM last night, flooding the Nogli drain. In Rohru, three youths died after their car fell into the Pabbar River due to heavy rain. A landslide also occurred on the Chandigarh-Manali four-lane highway.

State authorities reported that 533 roads remain closed across Himachal due to landslides and rain-related damage. Rescue and clearance operations are underway.

articles.title: CRPF Tragedy in J&K: Bunker Vehicle Falls into 200-Feet Gorge — 3 Jawans Dead, 15 Injured!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Udhampur (J&K): A tragic accident occurred around 10:30 AM on Thursday when a CRPF bunker vehicle plunged into a 200-feet-deep gorge in the Basantgarh area of Udhampur district. The mishap claimed the lives of 3 jawans and left 15 others injured, 5 of them critically.

body.html:
Udhampur (J&K): A tragic accident occurred around 10:30 AM on Thursday when a CRPF bunker vehicle plunged into a 200-feet-deep gorge in the Basantgarh area of Udhampur district. The mishap claimed the lives of 3 jawans and left 15 others injured, 5 of them critically.

According to CRPF officials, the vehicle carrying personnel skidded off the road and fell down a steep slope. Two bodies were recovered from the spot, and the injured were rushed to a nearby hospital.

Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh expressed concern over the incident. The administration and CRPF are closely monitoring the situation.
